I am reviewing the CreateMemo handler to confirm the webhook dispatch flow and signing mechanism.

The handler is `CreateMemo` in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go`. It calls `DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook` in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go`, which invokes `webhook.PostAsync(payload)` from the `internal/webhook` package. The delivery package is `github.com/usememos/memos/internal/webhook`, using standard `net/http` with a custom safe client.

The signing mechanism is HMAC-SHA256 with Standard Webhooks format. Requests include `webhook-id`, `webhook-timestamp`, and `webhook-signature` headers prefixed with "v1,". Secrets are stored as "whsec_<base64>".

The dispatcher function is in `memo_service_webhooks.go`. Line 603 appears to be only a comment stub.

The delivery package is `internal/webhook` (`github.com/usememos/memos/internal/webhook`), which uses `net/http`. The signing mechanism is HMAC-SHA256 under the Standard Webhooks specification. It signs requests with headers `webhook-id`, `webhook-timestamp`, and `webhook-signature` using a `whsec_` prefixed secret.

`DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook` in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go` triggers the chain. It calls `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook`, which invokes `webhook.PostAsync`. Workers then call `Post` from the `usedeliver` package.
